transport: ASGI Streamable HTTP /mcp; separate REST writes /api
filesystem: Owner-scoped persistent volume; application process is trusted; no hostile-file sandbox claim
external_ingress: Requires separately reviewed HTTPS TLS termination, configured base origin and explicit launch flag
authentication: Existing externally provisioned bearer credential SHA256 bindings; no credential creation, OAuth issuer or live key bundled
retention: Bounded per-owner task/version/receipt counts; no auto-deletion of historical evidence. A live retention/revocation/deletion operating policy remains a deployment decision.
completion: Advisory listed comparisons only; no host completion gate or automatic Muse acceptance
